observations.summary: The candidate has software-testing intuition but lacks a mature agent-evaluation model.
strengths: Understands deterministic unit tests and basic golden cases
weaknesses: Initially conflates exact-output tests with semantic evals
No clear separation of actor vs judge evaluation
misconceptions: Treats pass/fail tests as sufficient for stochastic agent quality
